blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Four flights were canceled, one was diverted to Cebu, and five others were delayed on Tuesday after aviation authorities found a pothole on the Iloilo International Airport runway and undertook emergency repairs. Engineer Diego Eric Abecendario, acting airport manager of the Iloilo International Airport and acting area manager of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) Area Center VI, confirmed in a local radio interview that foreign object debris (FOD) caused the pothole. Abecendario said canceling flights was necessary to prevent potential safety risks if aircraft operations continued under those runway conditions. READ: NAIA runway maintenance suspended […]...
